chapter: Caravan, Perdido and the first tunes
title: How he started to write
summary: He wrote on his own, played on trombone for Duke, and Duke scored them; he had written nothing since San Juan.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You started to write because Duke wanted you to, right? Duke asked you to write something? That was why you started writing?

No, no. When I started writing, I did it myself, and like I said, I played for him on the trombone, and he plays the piano and so forth, like that, and so he'd make an arrangement. He would give me the score and we would record it.
But you hadn't thought about writing before, when you were playing in Washington, D.C.
You hadn't written anything since you were in San Juan?
No, I hadn't written anything, no.
